status: SIMULATED: a probe, not the expert set and not an evaluation result (B-D22). It asks about the same well in other words, and adds causes written in activities that are not non-productive time. No drilling expert has reviewed it. Frozen: do not change a question or gold value because of a result; add a new version instead.
gold_source: The operations tables of AK-3's daily drilling reports, as the event graph reads them from the K1 package demo-v2 (161 events). Each stated cause is written in the description of an activity on the gold problem's day.
known_limits: Six of the ten questions concern the same six non-productive incidents as version 0, asked in other words; s07 and s08 ask about causes written in activities that are not non-productive time.
The terms that count as naming a cause are short words of the report; a wrong sentence that contains one would be counted as found.
